definitions.explanation: The governmental power to make laws. In Japan it belongs to the Diet, as one of the three separated powers.

examples.japanese: ⟦{国会|こっかい}→国会：02761_kokkai⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{立法権|りっぽうけん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{持|も}つ→持つ：00478_motsu⟧。
{立法権|りっぽうけん}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{国会|こっかい}→国会：02761_kokkai⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{属|ぞく}する→属する：12402_zokusuru⟧。
examples.english: Legislative power belongs to the Diet.

examples.japanese: {三権分立|さんけんぶんりつ}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、{立法権|りっぽうけん}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{行政権|ぎょうせいけん}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{司法権|しほうけん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{分|わ}けられている→分ける：02333_wakeru⟧。
examples.english: Under the separation of powers, legislative, executive, and judicial powers are divided.

notes:
One of the three powers in {三権分立|さんけんぶんりつ} (the separation of powers). Compound of {立法|りっぽう} (legislation) and {権|けん} (right, power).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {立法権|りっぽうけん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{持|も}つ→持つ：00478_motsu⟧: to hold legislative power
- {立法権|りっぽうけん}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{国会|こっかい}→国会：02761_kokkai⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{属|ぞく}する→属する：12402_zokusuru⟧: legislative power belongs to the Diet

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {行政権|ぎょうせいけん}: executive power — held by the Cabinet
- {司法権|しほうけん}: judicial power — held by the courts
